name: SAND-MathScience-DeepSeek-Qwen32B
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B (config.json max_position_embeddings 131072). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: GQA (standard; sliding_window set to full 131072 = inactive)
notes: ADDED 2026-11-01. SFT-only fine-tune of deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B on 27k synthetic samples (15k math + 12k science) from AMD's SAND pipeline, generated/validated by GPT-OSS-120b and screened against known test sets for contamination. Same tensor set as the base. Recorded because Table 1 prints base and ours in one table: AIME24 72.6 -> 83.85, AIME25 54.9 -> 78.33, GPQA 62.1 -> 68.72, while MATH500 goes the other way 94.3 -> 93.85 (a loss, omitted from the benchmark rows). Two caveats: the GPQA variant (main vs diamond) is never stated, and the card asks the reader to average multiple Pass@K passes for stability but does not say what it did for these numbers, so the sampling config behind them is unstated. The AIME deltas (+11.3, +23.4) are far too large to attribute to SFT alone on a distill that was already RL'd on math - reproduces most plausibly as a change of eval prompt/decode (card recommends a specific boxed-answer system prompt at inference) rather than new capability, and should be read as 'matches Qwen3-32B on this vendor harness'.
